name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Never pick up the box in the other room' (categorical never, no preference cue); soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost's own definition already encodes losing the key while the door is closed, so a plain Absence is the right template, and 'try not to' makes it soft; soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later' ('then or later' is a timing cue, so Response rather than RespondedExistence, with has_door_key as the condition and door_open as the consequent). The task commands nothing unconditionally — the box pickup is only prohibited and the key/door requirements are conditional preferences — so no goal clause is missing and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Never pick up the target box in the other room.
Try not to lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
Whenever you hold the door key, try to have the door open at that time or later.
